text:
maya (PM): quick sync — I'm drafting the PRD acceptance checklist for the PRD that gates staging -> prod for anything touching crypto/audit. pulling thoughts on minimum requirements (KMS/HSM, retention windows, evidence package) before I lock it.
sam (Security): thanks. key things: explicit KMS config per deployment type, HSM option for private/on-prem, immutable audit logs with signed entries, and retention policy with legal review. also need replayable evidence for SOC2/ISO audits.
jordan (Eng): for Hosted API we can default to AWS KMS + envelope keys. Dedicated can be customer-managed KMS. Private needs HSM integration doc (PKCS#11) + config schema.
lee (SRE): agree. operationally we need a rotation policy, key metadata export for incident response, and retention enforcement at the ingestion pipeline so old events are wiped according to policy.
taylor (Legal): retention windows need to be targeted per data class. propose: operational audit logs = 1y, security/evidence artifacts = 7y (subject to customer contract). will confirm with compliance team.
maya (PM): rough acceptance criteria draft — please react with thumbs or suggest edits:
- KMS: Default hosted KMS configured + opt-in customer-managed KMS per workspace
- HSM: documented on-prem HSM integration flow (PKCS#11) and test harness
- Audit logs: append-only, signed, tamper-evident, exportable for auditors
- Retention: configurable per workspace with company defaults (ops 365d, evidence 7y)
- Evidence bundle: reproducible artifact (prompts, model version, routing policy, token counts) for any production incident
- Rollout gate: staging must pass automated signing + evidence export tests before canary
sam (Security): small nit: "signed" should be verifiable signature + not just checksum. add: signature verification in the auditor-facing export.
jordan (Eng): implementation note: we'll augment log pipeline with signing step and a kms_key_id field in each envelope. sample retention config:
```
retention:
  audit_logs_days: 365
  evidence_archive_days: 2555  # ~7y
  min_retention_days: 90
```
maya (PM): @sam, @taylor — are we okay with 7y evidence default? taylor wants legal to confirm but we need a default now for PRD.
taylor (Legal): provisional yes, subject to customer-specific legal terms. document scope and opt-outs in PRD.
lee (SRE): question on storage: do we force WORM storage for exported evidence? that adds cost. maybe make it required for prod-enabled accounts and optional for low-tier.
sam (Security): WORM recommended for evidence archives. acceptance criteria should say "WORM or equivalent immutability guarantees (object lock, HSM-backed ledger)".
maya (PM): decision: include WORM for enterprise-tier by default; mark as optional for self-serve with warning banner. adding to PRD.
compliance-bot: checklist created: CR-3142 — "Crypto and Audit acceptance criteria (staging gate)". Please link PRD & RFC in CR-3142.
jordan (Eng): engineering tasks I see: sign-on-write pipeline, kms per-workspace support, export format v1 (tar + signed manifest), retention guards. I'll break into tickets.
maya (PM): actionable next steps:
1) @jordan - PRD section + RFC stub with proposed schema + sample config (due EOD Wed)
2) @sam - security review notes + verification tests (due Thu)
3) @taylor - legal retention confirmation + contract language (due Fri)
4) @lee - cost impact analysis for WORM option (due Fri)
please ack and I will fold into roadmap milestone.
sam (Security): ack :thumbsup:
jordan (Eng): ack
lee (SRE): ack
taylor (Legal): ack, will follow up with specifics.
maya (PM): thanks all — I'll update PRD and ping once CR-3142 is linked.
